title: The Evil Halloween Queen
notes: Everyday Bowie is only pages 4–5 (page 5 is mid-transform). Halloween Bowie from page 5 onward. Vamghoston is ONE unit of three creatures (vampire + ghost + skeleton) who must always appear together, never solo. Queen zaps with crescent-moon hand magic (no wand). Kid-safe Halloween: cartoon, not gore. Everyday Bowie casual colors (orange tee, blue shorts, white sneakers) were not in the story dump; lock them for continuity.

pages.sceneGoal: Book cover: Evil Halloween Queen as the dramatic focus in Halloween Town; title area kept clear.
Halloween Town in hot summer; the Evil Halloween Queen hiding in shade because it is too hot even at night.
Clear portrait of the Evil Halloween Queen matching her locked look (pale ghost skin, long black-and-orange hair, purple moon t-shirt, red lips, fangs, black boots).
Introduce the Vamghoston: skeleton, vampire, and ghost standing side by side as one team.
Everyday Bowie with blonde pigtails, orange t-shirt and blue shorts, excited for Halloween.
Bowie mid-conversion into Halloween Bowie with her Halloween Wand; same girl, blonde pigtails becoming orange high ponytail, everyday clothes dissolving into the Halloween costume.
Halloween night street: the Vamghoston see a trick-or-treater and walk up.
Skeleton grabs the trick-or-treater into the vampire's hands; cartoon-safe sparkly sip; ghost gobbles them toward Halloween Town. Kid-safe, no realistic blood.
Halloween Bowie is grabbed; skeleton accidentally gobbles her to Halloween Town while the vampire does NOT sip her (he looks forgetful).
Halloween Bowie in Halloween Town uses her wand to turn Halloween creatures back into humans and send them home.
Magic duel: Halloween Bowie zaps with her wand; the queen zaps the magic off Bowie with crescent-moon hand magic.
Pumpkins and jack-o-lanterns shake and bounce; Halloween Bowie stands strong and the queen cannot hurt her.

Queen mid-reform, shrinking much smaller than Halloween Bowie into the Nice Halloween Queen (same purple orange-moon shirt, fangs becoming a kind smile, hand magic fading — no wand). Scary monsters shrinking into toys in the background.
Vamghoston have become toys; other monsters are toys too; Halloween night moon hinting they can become monsters again only that night.
Friendly Halloween-night Vamghoston: vampire says Hi, ghost says Goodbye, then a silly sparkly ghost-poop swirl sends a kid gently home. No blood sucking.
Happy ending: Halloween Bowie having fun on Halloween with candy, pumpkins, and friends.
